essence: The list specifies multiple kinds of animals as acceptable victims.
The animal victim is endowed with knowledge, strength, and capability lasting up to seven births.
One should worship the multitude of yoginis with food, eatables, and other offerings.
The meat offering must be made in alkaline, sour, and sweet forms.
Offerings may be derived from trees, roots, flowers, or fruits.
